name: Dual-App Manifest Foundation (Parent + Child)
description: Two manifests (415 + 408 lines) proving dual-app topology: parent controller with 129 activities/21 services/14 receivers/8 providers and 37 non-spy permissions; child enforcement agent with AccessibilityService, DeviceAdmin, keep-alive services and block UIs.
behavior_summary: Declares the full component surface of both apps; parent holds zero enforcement components, child holds all of them.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for dual-app permission partitioning; Family OS adopts the same split with Device Owner on the child side.

name: ScreenTimeTool Weekly Schedule Encoding Engine
description: Kotlin object (160 lines) encoding weekly rules as 7 comma-joined day elements: -1=no limit, 86400=full day, seconds otherwise; hardcoded empty-list default '3600,-1,200,300,300,300,300'; HasInvalidSameSchedule is dead code.
behavior_summary: Serializes daily limits and start/end schedules into wire strings consumed by POST v4/app-block/save.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the encoding verbatim as the heart of the Family OS permission engine — human-readable and debuggable.

name: ControlsBean Cloud Distribution Model
description: Server-mediated rule distribution: parent POSTs, child pulls the full ControlsBean via GET v4/gather/controls-init, persists JSON in SharedPreferences 'controls_init_v5', hot-reloads via EventBus MMKVChangeEvent.
behavior_summary: Decouples rule editing from enforcement; works offline after sync; instant hot reload.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt as the official Family OS rule-distribution contract.

name: Parent Rule Contract (DeviceRuleBean / App1 / ScreenTime1)
description: Kotlin data classes with snake_case fields and no @SerializedName (Gson field-name serialization); DeviceRuleBean is a read-model only with zero writers.
behavior_summary: Defines the JSON schema exchanged between parent UI, cloud and child agent.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reuse the schema shape; rename to Family OS domain language.

name: Cloud REST API & MD5 Request Signing Layer
description: 175 parent endpoints (smali) plus child gather endpoints; signing vc = MD5(APP_KEY + sorted params + APP_FP) with hardcoded secrets (rejected); overridable hosts.
behavior_summary: All client-server communication; Bearer auth plus X- headers per request.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for endpoint inventory only; Family OS uses certificate pinning and server-issued secrets.

name: Match-Code Device Pairing Flow
description: Parent requests GET v4/match-code/get, displays code + QR; child logs in via POST v5/member/match-code-login; parent polls device-get for link discovery.
behavior_summary: Simple pairing with no complex accounts on the child device.

reusability_assessment.notes: Model for Family OS family-device linking.

name: Parent Notification Pull Pipeline
description: Server-stored alerts pulled periodically via GET v5/notification/list-get with cursor pagination; NotifyTool.getType classifies into dashboard card types; ParentNotifyService is keep-alive only.
behavior_summary: Delivers child events (youtube_alert, geo_fence, suspicious_sms...) as parent dashboard cards.

reusability_assessment.notes: Good base for the AI-fed parent dashboard cards.

name: Subscription & Entitlement Gate (isVip)
description: isVip() = (member_level == 1) OR future empower_expire; SKUs for monthly/quarterly/annual; server codes 492/509/513 disable locally; Google Play Billing 9.1.0.
behavior_summary: Server truth cached locally; paywall enforcement pattern.

reusability_assessment.notes: Pattern is sound; adapt SKUs to Family OS plans.

name: Child Accessibility Dispatcher
description: SCAccessibilityService (180 lines, pure dispatcher) forwards events to AccessibilityManager singleton when user role == 4; config typeAllMask + feedbackAllMask with canTakeScreenshot=true.
behavior_summary: Single entry point fanning out to global observers (usage/blocking) and per-package monitors.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference dispatcher architecture for the Family OS child agent.

name: Overlay Blocking Engine (No-Kill Policy)
description: Per-window-event priority evaluation (ScreenBlockHelper <- ScheduleBlockHelper <- AppBlockHelper); fullscreen TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY layer swallowing BACK; blocked apps are never killed (verified by exhaustive absence search); adaptive 30s/2s polling fallback via UsageStatsManager.
behavior_summary: Non-destructive blocking that survives without root or device-owner privileges.

reusability_assessment.notes: Use as fallback layer under Device Owner in Family OS; never-kill policy is UX-superior.

name: Anti-Tamper Battery (AppDefenceUtils)
description: 374-line utility trying 9 defences per event (throttled 1/60s): OEM launcher uninstall-dialog interception, 8-language date-settings detection, app-info and accessibility-page traps, AdminDefence; response g() locks the device via lockNow().
behavior_summary: Broad OEM coverage (Huawei/Xiaomi/Samsung) against uninstall, clock tampering and permission revocation.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adapt widely; add the missing password gate Family OS requires.

name: DeviceAdmin force-lock Stub Receiver
description: Near-empty receiver declaring only the force-lock policy; onDisableRequested returns null; used solely for DevicePolicyManager.lockNow().
behavior_summary: Minimal device-admin footprint: lock-only, no policies.

reusability_assessment.notes: Shows the minimal viable DeviceAdmin; Family OS goes further with Device Owner.

name: Social Content Scrapers (~38 Monitors)
description: ~38 per-package accessibility-node scrapers (Instagram80Monitor, WhatsApp80Monitor...) extracting message text; BrowserMonitor maps per-browser URL-bar view IDs.
behavior_summary: Wide monitoring surface for social apps via accessibility nodes.

reusability_assessment.notes: Wide but fragile (breaks on app updates) and policy-sensitive; secondary layer behind server-side AI in Family OS.

name: Server-Verdict Web Filter
description: On-device URL extraction, server-side verdict: blocking GET v1/gather/web-filter-check (10s timeout); cache 60s block / 300s allow; cleared on web_filter_update push; no local blocklist.
behavior_summary: Balances response time against server load; verdicts cached briefly.

name: FCM + WebSocket Command Plane
description: Dual carriers (FCM + persistent WebSocket with ws-token) feeding PushManager with id dedup (last 50); ChildPushListener handles ~30 actions directly, rest via EventBus; MainService pulls full ControlsBean on updates.
behavior_summary: Reliable server-to-device command delivery with dedup and hot reload.

reusability_assessment.notes: Ready-made parent->child command vocabulary; add per-command signatures (they have none).

name: Custom On-Device Geofence
description: Hand-rolled geofencing without Google APIs: fences from ControlsBean.gps_fence, haversine ComputeDistance.computeDistanceBetween, 5-minute dedup, POST v1/gather/geo-fence-log.
behavior_summary: Works without Google Mobile Services — critical for Yemen/China devices.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy for Family OS location module.

name: Keep-Alive & Battery-Evasion Package
description: Persistent MainService, :watch-process WatchDogService, mutual-restart DaemonProcess (126 lines), WakeUp receivers, evernote android-job, MIUI/Huawei boot lists (no Oppo/Vivo).

reusability_assessment.notes: Comprehensive reference; review the notification-hiding trick for Play policy risk.

name: Security Anti-Patterns Catalog
description: Documented vulnerabilities explicitly rejected for Family OS: trust-all TLS (empty checkServerTrusted), usesCleartextTraffic=true, hardcoded APP_KEY/APP_FP signing secrets, leaked Google Maps key in manifest.
behavior_summary: Negative reference: what Family OS must never do.

reusability_assessment.notes: Family OS: certificate pinning + secrets from a settings server.
